about: Word lists the bank is built from. unit: hand-made K-8 unit words (word, part of speech). nawl: New Academic Word List 1.2 headwords and part of speech (Browne, Culligan & Phillips 2013, CC BY-SA 4.0). builtin: Word Sounds words that have a recording and are not blocked. common: the 10,000 most common Word Sounds words by reading-library rank. blocked: Word Sounds blocked or soft words (never headwords). zipf: CYP-LEX Zipf frequency in children's books (CC BY 4.0), for these words and their forms.
